messages:
nicole: idea Can we add a tiny "Estimated units" hint in the Console for embeddings before users call the API? would cut 413/billing surprises
rajan: +1. we already calculate dims/bytes at ingress. should we surface both?
evelyn: runtime: dims are the better cost predictor, bytes better for transport limits. suggest a one-line: 'Est: 2.2k dims  4.6 KB payload' and a suggested split button
sam: UX: keep it minimal, with a details pane showing math + example curl to split. offer an 'auto preflight' setting
nicole: telemetry: emit embed_console.preflight_shown and embed_console.preflight_applied with dims,size,route_id,tenant_id
rajan: implement as a separate preflight endpoint /v1/embeddings/preflight. cheap, rate-limited, opt-in via header X-Embed-Preflight:1; return hint in headers x-embed-hint: dims=2200;size=4600;split=3
evelyn: prefer separate endpoint. ensure estimator uses identical math as billing and splitter. for mixed-dim inputs return 'mixed' flag and suggest client-side chunking
sam: console should call preflight only on paste/upload or when preview enabled. show sample chunking snippet for mixed dims
nicole: rollout: UI behind feature flag, telemetry on, server endpoint behind flag. canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
infra-bot: deploy initiated by rajan: canary embed-preflight flag enabled for 10% of tenants :rocket:
rajan: action items: add endpoint + flag + telemetry hooks
evelyn: action items: parity tests vs billing + splitter; handle edgecases
sam: action items: UI mock + settings toggle
nicole: i'll own telemetry spec and dashboard mock. sync tomorrow 11:00. :thumbsup:
